subject: SentinelOps BCP: live-witness coordination, RTO/RPO metrics and artifacts
messages:
From: Alex Bishop <alex.bishop@sentinelops.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: live witness for RTO/RPO + supporting artifacts

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the quick walkthrough earlier. As part of Sentinel Financial's SOC 2 scope we need to verify your BCP/DR assertions with artifacts and a live witness of a warm-start failover sequence (or recorded equivalent). Specifically our auditor team is asking for:  
- RTO and RPO measurement snapshots for the last 3 scheduled tests (timestamps + methodology)  
- A short excerpt of the failover runbook that covers the warm-start flow and cache-warmup steps  
- Warm-cache trace that shows KV cache restoration timing (TLS redacted ok)  
- A 30–45 minute live witness slot (Zoom) where ops walks through the procedure and answers a few auditor questions

Can your team provide these artifacts and a couple of possible witness windows next week? We prefer Mon/Tue afternoon (US ET). If there are any NDAs or access links we need to sign, flag them and we will route internally.

Best,
Alex
SentinelOps Compliance
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Bishop <alex.bishop@sentinelops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: live witness for RTO/RPO + supporting artifacts

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely provide what you need. Quick plan:  

1) Artifacts: I will attach the runbook excerpt, the RTO/RPO snapshot and a warm-cache trace extract to our next message. We will redact any sensitive tokens before sending.  
2) Live witness windows (US ET): Tue 2027-04-13 14:00–14:45 ET or Wed 2027-04-14 15:00–15:45 ET. Please confirm which works and whether you want screen-sharing only or plan to request a remote session to observe logs.  
3) Audit logistics: If Sentinel wants a recording we can provide the Zoom recording and the ops runbook PDF; if you need a signed attestation or an NDA amendment, please send the DocuSign link.

I'll loop in Marissa to confirm the artifact packaging and Ben to coordinate the witness runbook owners.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Customer Reliability (on-call)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T11:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: live witness for RTO/RPO + supporting artifacts

Adding ops details — attaching the artifacts we discussed: runbook_sentinel_warmstart_excerpt.pdf (selected sections only), rto_rpo_metric_snapshot_20270331.csv, warm_cache_warmup_trace_20270330.log, and ops_personnel_matrix_v2.xlsx. Summary notes below:  

- RTO methodology: measured from failover start (leader demote call) to 95th-percentile request success against synthetic warmstart traffic. Snapshots include test ids and start/finish timestamps.  
- RPO observed: typical delta <= 30s for KV-sync under our standard warm-replication profile; the CSV includes the raw delta samples for the last three scheduled rehearsals.  
- Warm-cache trace: included trace shows KV restore completed at t+22s for a 2M keyset (this is the typical size for your env); we redacted node ids and session tokens.  

Ben will run the live walk-through; he can simulate a warm-start path and toggle the cache-warmup so auditors can see the tracer. 

—Marissa
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Bishop <alex.bishop@sentinelops.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: SentinelOps Compliance <compliance@sentinelops.com>, Priya Rao <priya@sentinelops.com>
Date: 2027-04-13T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: live witness for RTO/RPO + supporting artifacts

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. A couple of quick follow-ups before we finalize:  
- Can you include the test IDs and the playback snippets for one of the rehearsals (we need evidence that the measurement was repeatable)? If possible, add the tracer segment as an MP4 or provide a Zoom recording URL.  
- For the witness slot: Wed 2027-04-14 15:00–15:45 ET works for our auditors. Please send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a short agenda (15 min runbook walkthrough, 20 min Q&A with auditors, 10 min buffer).  
- We also need an attestation line from a manager confirming the artifacts are unaltered since the test — a short paragraph in the email body is fine.

If you can get us the playback/recording and the calendar invite by EOD tomorrow that would keep our timeline intact.

Alex
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Bishop <alex.bishop@sentinelops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: live witness for RTO/RPO + supporting artifacts

Alex / Sentinel team — confirmed. Deliverables and logistics:  

- Artifacts attached (redacted): runbook_sentinel_warmstart_excerpt.pdf, rto_rpo_metric_snapshot_20270331.csv, warm_cache_warmup_trace_20270330.log, ops_personnel_matrix_v2.xlsx. The CSV includes the three test IDs and raw deltas; the trace extract is the tracer segment you requested.  
- Playback/recording: we uploaded the rehearsal clip to Drive and added the link to the related_links field above. If you prefer an MP4 attached to the invite, we can include that.  
- Live witness: Wed 2027-04-14 15:00–15:45 ET (Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=live-witness). Agenda: 15m runbook walkthrough (Ben), 20m Q&A (Marissa + Jordan), 10m auditor buffer. Calendar invite has been sent to the addresses on your side.  
- Attestation: I confirm on behalf of Redwood Inference that the artifacts provided are true extracts of the rehearsal and have not been modified since the recorded rehearsal. 

If auditors need additional log slices or a different file format, tell us in the call and we will export immediately. See you Wednesday.

Regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
Attachments: runbook_sentinel_warmstart_excerpt.pdf (pdf), rto_rpo_metric_snapshot_20270331.csv (csv), warm_cache_warmup_trace_20270330.log (log), ops_personnel_matrix_v2.xlsx (xlsx)
